implementation_state: Supervised warmup is being built on branch node/7e-2b-warmup as a pure offline library entry point: it takes a dataset snapshot and returns a trained ensemble, a verified ModelCommit with lineage, and an honest report. It installs nothing, runs on no schedule, and is not reachable from the running product.
unblock_condition: Dispatched: implement offline warmup only, with a documented sample projection, deterministic and verifiable output, a disjoint holdout, and no reachable activation path.
notes: This is the first node that consumes the collected dataset, and the first that would train anything at all. Training is authorized here; activation is not.
Activation is a different call: ShadowEngine::swap and try_train_and_swap install a predictor, and both are forbidden in this node. Installing a verified commit is node 7E-2F.

The accepted training and evaluation surface is built on the legacy TrainingSample, while production collects the canonical OutcomeTrainingSample. The projection between them must be explicit and proven unable to turn a non-success into a positive label.
ModelEnsemblePredictor::train is the infallible wrapper that expects; warmup must use the fallible form only.
No bandit or RL (7E-2C), no calibration (7E-2D), no durable journal (7E-2E), and no snapshot or activation machinery (7E-2F) belongs here.
